item.title: OwnTracks Recorder before 1.0.5 Format String via Stored tid Value
item.description: OwnTracks Recorder before 1.0.5 contains a format string vulnerability in json response() and related output functions that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute code by storing a malicious tid value. Attackers can publish locations via POST /pub or MQTT with printf specifiers in tid, then read them back through GET /api/0/last to leak addresses and write memory.

item.title: Cri-o: cri-o: writable linklogs bind mount allows pods to redirect privileged conmon log writes
item.description: A flaw was found in CRI-O. When the optional Linux LinkLogs feature is enabled, the host pod log directory is bind-mounted into a pod emptyDir and is intended to be read-only, but Linux ignores MS RDONLY on the initial bind and the CRI mount stays writable. A non-privileged UID 0 container can place a symlink at a future kubelet log path so that privileged conmon later appends attacker-controlled log data to an…

item.title: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 Policy Bypass on Windows via Path Separators
item.description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a policy bypass vulnerability on Windows that allows attackers to evade path-based security policies by mixing forward slash and backslash separators. Attackers can supply crafted image file paths using alternate separators to read or write image files that the configured policy is intended to block.

item.title: SiYuan before 3.8.10 Stored XSS to RCE via Attribute View Name
item.description: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability, an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-44670, because renderAVAttribute() inserts an Attribute View name unescaped into the database row attribute panel header. Attackers who can persist the name, such as via the setAttrViewName action, can inject an onerror handler that runs OS commands through Node.js when a desktop user opens the panel.

item.title: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
item.description: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.
